assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's one curated REVIEWED item at basis_commit, read end to end with its front matter: the canonical character monograph series/fx-fighter-kurumi-chan/characters/takane-yasuko-manga.md (FXK-P008, version 1.0, 96,762 bytes, status canonical), a self-contained portrait of the Japanese collected manga main narrative V01-V10 to V10 i0156 (24 April 2017), including the V10 flashback to November-December 2013, located by volume and page occurrence (Vnn iNNNN) and by the project's observation, decision-episode, claim and open-question IDs (FXK-Vnn-Ennn, FXK-Vnn-Dnnn, FXK-Vnn-Cnnn, FXK-SYN-Cnnn, Vnn-Unn), with brief Japanese quotations. Its publication note records an independent self-containment PASS and a fidelity PASS after revision; it re-opened thirty-four pages and one enlargement. Covers, flaps, afterwords, bonus strips, later volumes and adaptations are excluded by the monograph itself. The volume readings, the decision and evidence ledger, Studies B and C and the audits it cites are not curated on this subject, and no claim rests on them directly; where the monograph reports a study's argument, the claim rests on the monograph's report. No primary source page was inspected for this assessment.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: V01-V10 story time to V10 i0156 (24 April 2017), in located states: 2013 (the V10 i0066-i0079 flashback: entry into FX on 5 November, the short of 14 November, the forced liquidation of 3 December and the あふぃちゃん persona; late revelation, so these are her memories at every later state); the V01 night as あふぃちゃん, before the late-May 2014 blog post (a cut on fear, then a full-size reversal announced, execution INFERENCE MODERATE-HIGH); V02 (late May to 15 July 2014), named at i0074 and split at i0155-i0157, where wounded pride and the resolve to watch over Mebuki lead to stated rules and the contest; V03 (late July to October 2014): the return, one minimum-lot trade cut, the frozen chase, abstention, and the refused warning to Mebuki (i0141-i0143); V04 (before 23 November 2014), split at i0046-i0047 (the exit decided on her own record) and at i0142-i0143 (silence on the train), with the meeting planned by i0147-i0149; V05 (November to December 2014): コミチア, the outing, the editors and the confrontation with Mochiko; V06-V07 (Christmas 2014 to January 2015): the exit tested and held, the dropped 引き際 hint, the franc-shock message; V08 (January 2015): two chat lines only; V09 (2015 to April 2017); V10 (April 2017): manga artist with shares since autumn 2016 and advice to Nana. What the page never shows her learning (that 'ともこ' was Mochiko, the loan's rate and family security, Kurumi's V08 crisis, the consequences of her advice to Nana) stays unknown to her in every state. Nothing after V10 i0156 is evidence.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, applying the owner calibration rulings recorded there (B/C boundary, single counting of uncertainty, dialogue constrained-use test, chronology splits, relationship-transfer safeguards and control-state attribution) and the owner's A/B boundary direction of 24 November 2026 in PR #694, not yet recorded in the policy, applied to the overall tier. Evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The monograph gives values (friendship as showing up, V04 i0132, V05 i0138; owning one's choices without letting that end care, V04 i0136, V05 i0133-i0134; openness between friends, V05 i0135), goals (design, then professional manga, and enough money for decent food, V10 i0068-i0069), fears (poverty; repeating her own failure, V03 i0019; losing a friend to FX, V05 i0138) and vulnerabilities (pride wounded by comparison, V02 i0154-i0155; self-doubt, V03 i0093; an unvoiced need for encouragement, V05 i0113). Section 12 turns them into conditional rows with support grades and counterconditions: a friend visibly at risk draws a direct, early warning backed by her own losses and pursuit in person (HIGH), except when the news arrives fast and partial under time pressure (she may fall silent and reproach herself afterwards, V04 i0142-i0143; in the one located case she then arranged to meet the lender within days and confronted her, V04 i0147-i0149 and V05 i0129-i0139, an example rather than a predicted next action or deadline) or when the friend is winning and not confiding (a soft hint, dropped, V06 i0147). Her central habit, trusting observed results over her own confidence, is stated in her own words at the turning point (V04 i0046). It predicts her errors in the states where they occur: the V03 trade at about 17x and the announced chase, concealing her own past while demanding openness, the dropped hint, and misjudging Mochiko (V04 i0093) and Kurumi's father (V09 i0095-i0097). The V01 full-size reversal was announced (execution INFERENCE MODERATE-HIGH); it is not an error predicted by applying her later rule to an earlier state but, with 2013, evidence that the restraint of V03-V04 was learned from her own record rather than a timeless rule (sections 4 and 13). Not A: the profile is untested, most rows outside the friend-at-risk and FX-refusal rows are MODERATE or one episode, the HIGH row is carried mainly by Mebuki, why she hid her past is not shown, and the V02 return has two unranked motives (section 13). Not C: the account states what changes her response (closeness, time to think, whether the friend is losing, and dated state) and where it stops.

Section 11 dates real change: her trading rule (liquidated in 2013; the V01 cut and announced reversal; V02 stated rules; the V03 cut and abstention; the V04 exit on her own record; the V06 i0147 farewell; the V07 i0011 withdrawal; 'FXは やらんけど!' at V09 i0112-i0113; unleveraged shares in 2017), her vocation, the disclosure of her past, her tie to Mochiko, and her role from foil to warner to mentor. It states what does not change (voice, rabbits and brand, care toward the people near her, food as the unit of money, spending on others, reticence about her own hurt), separates the V10 2013 flashback as late revelation from development, and keeps story order and reading order apart. The exit is tested once and holds (V06 i0147). Not A: V08 is two chat lines, 2015-2017 is lightly sampled, December 2013 to V01 is unshown, and whether the exit would survive a large gain or a cancelled serial is untested (section 11). Not C: the states are located, and the cause of the main change is given in her own words (V04 i0046).

Section 6 constrains her Japanese closely: あたし in every register from 2013 to 2017, polite speech included; four lettered 私, all outside speech balloons and UNRESOLVED (V04-U10), not a balloon form; ウチ at V09 i0109 not counted as a first-person form; a rough, masculine-leaning plain register with listed endings, verb forms, vocatives and expletives; shifts by audience (polite です/ます under evaluation, authority or fear, keeping あたし, V02 i0147, V04 i0126, V05 i0121-i0123; the stammer and くるみさん once, V09 i0095; cowed once by a junior, V09 i0150); address by listener (芽吹, お前, てめー; 萌智子 to her face from V05; 社長 in 2017; くるみ; ばなな); vocabulary habits (precise trader and gamer jargon, a death idiom for money, FX words moved into art and food, mock-heroic, hyperbole as affection); a reused formula (V01 i0152; V05 i0116); and an inner-outer pattern in which she is direct aloud about others' danger and keeps her own hurt in thought. Not A: her voice is lettering, two V05 dialect-like negatives are a one-off, the V06 i0147 lines are unattributed, and her written blog voice is a few strings. Not C: forms, shifts and their triggers are located from 2013 to 2017.

Sections 1, 5 and 8 give a stable ordinary life across volumes: part-time work and drawing at night, goods and hair-clip design, arcade dance games, beer at dinner, hosting and running the grill at the Christmas yakiniku (V06 i0145-i0146), her flat as the group's venue (V09 i0109), study for her comic (V09 i0087), frugal meals (梅干し茶漬け, V03 i0007, i0022), food as the unit in which she imagines money, rabbits and her own brand on everything, and treating others when she has little (V10 i0073; V04 i0061; V05 i0128), beside a stated expectation that winners pay (V06 i0141). Situational choices are kept apart from preferences (section 8). Not A: her part-time job, her family and her 2017 private life outside the office are not shown. Not C: the habits recur across settings and volumes with locators.

Section 7 reads each tie in both directions and dates it: Mebuki (warnings while denying her own trading, V02; the refused warning and the insult, V03 i0141-i0143; the night search and the silence on the train, V04; the confrontation on her behalf, V05; treats and a rand warning, V09 i0117); Mochiko (fear, suspicion, a planned confrontation that asks for friendship and openness, then banter and commerce, with Mochiko's private resentment of being known); Kurumi (care at a distance in brief words, never pressed as Mebuki is, with two compatible explanations at EVALUATION MODERATE); Nana (the declined 2013 invitation; in 2017 a job, a secret kept and affinity advice); and others (the editor, the fan, Kurumi's father). A table records what she knew and did not know at each volume's end. Conduct is conditioned on closeness, on whether the friend is losing or winning, and on time to think. Not A: the Kurumi difference rests on an evaluation, Kizuna and Inago are barely sampled, her family is absent, and her response to Kurumi's V08 crisis is never shown. Not C: her conduct varies by relationship in located, explained ways.

Thought balloons and unballooned asides give her interior at each major decision: wounded pride and the resolve to watch over Mebuki (V02 i0155, i0157), self-doubt (V03 i0093), the arm frozen over '前と同じで' (V03 i0019), hurt after the insult (V03 i0143), the reasoned exit (V04 i0046), self-reproach and moral judgment alone on the train (V04 i0143), the wish for kindness (V05 i0113), and the 2013 decision in self-report (V10 i0068-i0069). Section 6 states the pattern: what she thinks about other people she mostly also says to them, and the gap opens over herself. Not A: the monograph warns that much of her interior is short and comic and grades interior claims accordingly; why she hid her past is never shown; V08 has no interior and 2015-2017 little. Not C: her reasons at the turning points are lettered, not inferred.

The monograph locates modes: for a friend she argues directly and early and persists after a rebuff (V03 i0141-i0142; V04 i0132); she plans a confrontation with the person she blames, opening with thanks and payment, admitting she is being 'イジワル', pressing with drink and ending with a threat and a word of goodwill (V05 i0127-i0139); on her own behalf she bristles in private (V04 i0053; V05 i0116); with fast, partial news she falls silent (V04 i0142); she apologizes when a confrontation is mistaken (V09 i0095-i0097). Not B: the planned confrontation, the silence and the mistaken confrontation each rest on one scene, open conflict on her own behalf is never sampled beyond private bristling, and escalation past words is never shown. Not D: each mode is located with its counterconditions.

Her stated moral reasoning is located: her own choices are her responsibility, and a friend's responsibility never ends care (V04 i0136; V05 i0133-i0134); lending a friend money to trade is wrong (V04 i0143, in thought) and interest between friends objectionable (V05 i0131), voiced as 'あたしの個人的な 意見' rather than imposed as a rule (V05 i0134); friends owe each other openness (V05 i0135); and Study B's duty to warn and intervene, as the monograph reports it. The discovery row claims no ethics dimension, and this grade claims no broader moral or political reasoning. Not B: the reasoning rests on a few V04-V05 scenes, her own concealment sits against the openness she demands with no motive shown, so how she weighs her own disclosure is not established, and a rival reading of the V04 silence (deference to Mebuki's choice) is kept open. Not D: the reasoning in each located case is on the page and consistent across them.

Sections 3 and 6 document self-mockery and hyperbole that turn her ordeals into jokes (V04 i0040, i0133), hyperbolic insult as affection and relief (V04 i0131), mock-heroic self-naming (V01 i0149; V10 i0079), FX words moved into food and art (V06 i0146; V05 i0106), refusal by joke ('やめい!', V06 i0147), and trailing or cut-off speech when she is serious (V06 i0147; V03 i0142). Not B: much of her comedy is drawn (her tiny figure, gag faces, asides) rather than lettered, and the evidence describes a style and its functions by example without establishing when play gives way in ordinary scenes. Not D: the style is specific and located across volumes.

The curated monograph covers every appearance within the V01-V10 boundary, states evidence density by volume (LOW-MODERATE in V01, MODERATE in V02, MODERATE-HIGH in V03-V04, V06-V07 and V09-V10, HIGH in V05, LOW in V08), re-opened thirty-four pages and one enlargement to verify its quotations and attributions (section 14), and passed independent self-containment and fidelity checks. Its claims carry locators and graded labels. Not A: she is a supporting character with thin V01 and V08 presence, the assessment rests on one derived portrait, and the readings, ledger, studies and audits that carry the underlying observations are not curated on this subject. Not C: coverage of the admitted boundary is comprehensive rather than sampled.

The monograph states affirmative limits: apart from the first 2013 week, every trade of hers the page closes ends in a loss (section 10); she never presses Kurumi as she presses Mebuki (section 7); her exit from FX holds when tested by a friend's large gain (V06 i0147); she is never shown telling anyone the 2013 story, learning who 'ともこ' was, learning of Kurumi's V08 crisis or learning what came of her advice to Nana (sections 2, 7, 11); her 2013 conduct contradicts a temperament reading of her restraint (sections 4, 13); and it gives a counterexample list (section 13) and an abstention list (section 12), including that the friend-at-risk row does not extend to strangers. Not A: some limits rest on what the page does not show rather than on contrary conduct. Not C: the limits are stated affirmatively and located.

States carry dates, ages and locators: 5 and 14 November and 3 December 2013 (V10 i0066-i0079); 20 in 2014 and 23 in April 2017 (V01 i0144; V02 i0074; V09 i0142); late May 2014 for the blog retirement; 76,573円 at the 15 July 2014 contest base and 71,052円 by 19 September (V02 i0159; V03 i0155); 23 November 2014 for コミチア; Christmas 2014; shares since autumn 2016 (V10 i0091); and 24 April 2017 as the boundary. Sections 2 and 11 keep story order and reading order apart. Not A: December 2013 to V01, the V01 night's date and much of 2015-2017 are unprinted. Not C: the chronology is explicit and fine-grained across the boundary.

conditions: Output is illustrative written Japanese, never quotation; her voice is lettering, so no pitch, tempo or performed delivery is claimed (section 6, Limits of the medium).
Self-reference is あたし in every register, polite speech included; 私 is not used in balloon speech (the four lettered 私 are outside balloons and UNRESOLVED), and ウチ is not a first-person form.

Register follows section 6: the rough, masculine-leaning plain style with intimates (ねー, だろ, じゃねーか, ぜ, しやがって, おい, あのなぁ, expletives); polite です/ます under evaluation, authority or fear of an adult stranger, keeping あたし and possibly stammering; a brief 'お…おう…' when a junior asks a favour (one instance).
Address follows the listener and date: 芽吹, お前 or てめー to Mebuki; 萌智子 to her face from V05 and 社長 in 2017; くるみ; ばなな for Nana.

Aloud she is direct about another person's danger and about her opinions; her own hurt, self-doubt and wish for kindness stay in thought (section 6, Inner and outer speech), and the 2013 story is not volunteered.
The interlocutor is Mebuki, Mochiko, Kurumi, Nana, an editor, or an adult stranger or official; another peer is a separate, lower-confidence condition limited to the register rules.
scenario_readiness.note: The pronoun, register, address and inner-outer rules constrain illustrative Japanese closely enough for bounded use. Not READY: the evidence is lettering, some attributions are unresolved (the four 私 letterings; V06 i0147), and her written blog voice is a few strings. Not NOT_READY: the forms and their triggers are located from 2013 to 2017.

conditions: A friend visibly at risk from FX or debt, in a state from V02 on: predict a direct, early warning in rough plain speech backed by her own losses, a visit in person if she cannot reach the friend, and renewed help after a rebuff (section 12, HIGH). Mebuki is the main sampled case; transfer to another close friend is a separate, lower-confidence extrapolation, and the row does not extend to strangers or to readers of her blog.

Counterconditions: with unwelcome news delivered fast and partially under time pressure, she may fall silent and reproach herself afterwards (V04 i0142-i0143); in the one located case she later arranged to meet the lender within days and confronted her (V04 i0147-i0149; V05 i0129-i0139), which is an example, not a predicted next action or deadline; with a friend who is winning and not confiding, predict a soft hint that is dropped (V06 i0147). Abstain on her response to a friend in a suicidal crisis, which the page never shows her learning of.

Invited to trade FX from V04 on: predict an immediate refusal with humour (HIGH within V04-V10). Investing that is not FX, in the 2017 state: unleveraged, long-horizon, bought as support, with affinity-based advice to a friend (MODERATE, one episode).

A counterfactual return to trading predicts, from her 2014 record, rules first, minimum size, a quick cut, a voiced chase that may freeze, and abstention after a loss (MODERATE). The 2013 state is the opposite (escalation after an early win, a round-number ceiling, held to liquidation), so the state must be named.

Evaluated by an authority or an adult stranger: polite です/ます and honesty about her limits even to her own disadvantage. Flattered and then rejected: private anger and an immediate new target. Unexpected success: thanks to those who helped and spending on others.

Include her mistakes: concealing her own past while demanding openness, the V01 full-size reversal as announced (execution INFERENCE MODERATE-HIGH; it belongs to the state before her V02 rules and shows her later restraint is learned, not a rule to apply backwards), the V03 leveraged trade, silence when it mattered, the dropped warning, misjudging people (V04 i0093; V09 i0095-i0097), and advice by affinity whose relayed unit rule failed for the stock chosen (V10 i0104-i0105).

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named state from the temporal boundary: 2013 (the V10 flashback); the V01 night as あふぃちゃん; V02 before or after i0155-i0157; V03; V04 before or after the i0046 exit and the i0142-i0143 silence; V05; V06-V07; V09; or the 2017 state of V09-V10. The 2013 liquidation belongs to her at every later state; what the page never shows her learning (that 'ともこ' was Mochiko, the loan's rate and family security, Kurumi's V08 crisis, what came of her advice to Nana) stays unknown to her in every state.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Mebuki as neighbour and closest friend; Mochiko as feared senior, then confronted lender, then client and teasing peer; Kurumi as a friend cared for at a distance; Nana as old schoolmate and, in 2017, pupil; an editor; an adult stranger or official. Another close friend is a separate, lower-confidence transfer; strangers affected by her advice, her family, romantic partners and 2017 colleagues beyond a few lines are unsampled.
setting_constraints: Contemporary Japan within her located circumstances, 2013-2017: her school in 2013, her flat, Mebuki's door and the city at night, the game centre, cafés, the sushi bar, the Christmas yakiniku, the コミチア booth and its editors, the 2017 office.
No real market history, no market outcome invented to settle a prediction, no post-V10 events, no family scene, no romantic or intimate scene and no cross-series setting.

scenario_readiness.note: Bounded extrapolation supported by a conditional profile with stated counterconditions and an abstention list. Not READY: the profile is untested, most rows outside the friend-at-risk and FX-refusal rows are MODERATE or one episode, and her response to a friend's severe crisis is never shown. Not NOT_READY: the conditions that change her choices are located and stated.

conditions: Settings sampled by the monograph: her flat as the group's venue, a game centre, cafés and dinners, the Christmas yakiniku, the sushi bar, her コミチア booth, and the 2017 office where she is an outsider.

Predict self-mockery, rough affectionate banter, beer, food as the measure of money, rabbits and her brand, frugality for herself and treating others when she has little, and protest when she is made to pay (V07 i0021-i0026).
Her part-time work, family, life outside the circle and 2017 private life are not established and are not filled in.
scenario_readiness.note: Ordinary conduct located across ten volumes, bounded to the sampled settings. Not READY: much of her comedy is drawn, and her work and family life are blank. Not NOT_READY: the habits and their settings are located.

conditions: Obligations among friends over FX, lending, warning and disclosure, in a named state.

Predict the stated reasoning: her own choices are her responsibility; a friend's choice is the friend's responsibility, but that never ends care; lending to a friend to trade is wrong and interest between friends objectionable, voiced as her personal opinion rather than imposed as a rule; friends should be open with each other.
Predict that she does not volunteer her own past even while asking openness of others, without asserting why.
Moral, political or institutional questions beyond her own ties, and her responsibility to her blog's readers, are not evidenced and are not predicted.
scenario_readiness.note: Her reasoning is on the page in each located case, so bounded prediction of what she says is supported. Not READY: it rests on a few V04-V05 scenes, and the concealment contradiction is unexplained. Not NOT_READY: the reasoning is consistent across the located cases.

Not assessed: the monograph marks the dimension UNTESTED (section 9). The evidence boundary is recorded as the intimate-untested known limit. No state is claimed either way, so this records no finding about how she would behave in a romantic situation.

conditions: Her art work, 2014-2017: fast output (V05 i0123-i0124; V07 i0041; V09 i0110-i0111); takes specific, honest critique and answers it with her real aims (V05 i0121-i0124); rejects advice that ignores what she loves (cats over rabbits, V03 i0156; V06 i0099); re-targets at once after rejection (V05 i0116); promises a fix by the next day to an editor's harsh verdict (V10 i0010-i0011, caller INFERENCE MODERATE). Her weak story construction persists (V05 i0122; V09 i0086).
Polite です/ます with editors and professionals, keeping あたし; refuses the title 先生 (V10 i0081, reported, LOW-MODERATE).

Her own trading by dated state (2013 escalation; 2014 rules, minimum size, cut and abstention; FX refused from V04; 2017 cash shares as support), with no figure for any 2017 holding; abstain on whether she would re-enter FX.
Money advice to a friend: from her own losses (V02-V05) or, in 2017, shares by affinity (one episode). Her part-time job, her serial's fate and her pen name are not predicted.
scenario_readiness.note: Located professional conduct as an artist and, by dated state, as a trader. Not READY: her 2015-2017 working life is lightly sampled and the investing-advice row is one episode. Not NOT_READY: the artistic and trading rows recur with locators.

known_limits.statement: Section 12 states that its operational profile is a summary of observed regularities, not a tested model of the character, and confers no reconstruction capability; no held-out test of its predictions is reported.
Why she hid her trading past is not shown: shame, protection of the blogger persona and the wish to warn as a neutral party all fit, and none is shown (section 13).

Her V02 return to trading and entry into the contest has two motives on the page, protection of Mebuki and wounded pride, beside her V04 account that she had traded all along; the page does not rank them (section 13).
The V04 i0142 silence is read as a failure in the moment under time pressure; a rival reading, deference to Mebuki's right to choose, is kept open with weaker support (section 13).

Her restraint is learned and is predicted only under conditions like those of 2014-2017; the 2013 flashback shows the same person escalating to liquidation (sections 4 and 13), so every trading prediction names the state.
The HIGH friend-at-risk row is carried mainly by Mebuki; Kurumi is a differently conditioned case, and the row does not extend to strangers or to readers of her blog (section 12).

The page never shows her learning that 'ともこ' was Mochiko, the loan's rate and family security, Kurumi's V08 crisis, or what came of her advice to Nana, so her responses to them are abstentions (sections 7, 11 and 12).

Her voice is lettering and much of her comedy is drawn; the four 私 letterings are UNRESOLVED, the V06 i0147 '4桁万円' and '簡単' lines are not attributed to her, and two V05 dialect-like negatives are a one-off (section 6).
Evidence density is LOW-MODERATE in V01 and LOW in V08, where she is two chat lines, and her interior is often short and comic (Orientation).

The monograph marks the romantic and intimate dimension UNTESTED: no attraction, romantic history or intimate preference is shown, and her strongest attachments are friendships (section 9). This is an evidence boundary, not a finding about romantic behavior.
Nothing after V10 i0156 is evidence; the later outcomes of her advice to Nana, her serial and her own future face events beyond the boundary and are not scoreable (section 13).

The volume readings, the decision and evidence ledger, Studies B and C and the audits that carry the underlying observations are not curated on this subject, so every claim here rests on the portrait's summaries and locators.

Her family and childhood, her life between December 2013 and V01 apart from the blog, the origin of the 76,573円, her part-time job, her 2017 income and holdings, her pen name and her serial's fate are not printed.
